title: zkCreditScore
tagline: zkCreditScore lets you prove your credit worthiness using zk proofs.
description:
zkCreditScore is a privacy preserving protocol where you don't need to share all your transactions data to prove your credit worthiness to the DeFi protocols.
This protocol can be integrated and used with wide range of application to provide a secure and trustless way to prove credit worthiness of a user.
how_its_made:
We are leveraging Noir language to write circuits. 
- We have used Vite + React + TS to build our frontend application
- The web app is developed to make integration and access to financial products/dashboard easier for users.
- The proofs are generated and verified off-chain.
- Only category of the user's credit score is shared with the dapp and all other information is kept private.
